title: Projects & Mastery Practice 1
statement:
Module 6 (Projects & Mastery) covers: css architecture at scale, css capstone, cascade layers, view transitions, anchor positioning, css tooling. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 1: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (CSS Architecture at Scale).
hints: Re-read the CSS Architecture at Scale lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
